g_policy.reason: The banner is opt-in and its offer copy states the reward (30 minutes without sponsored stories). Declining changes nothing, and the 'if the ad fails' field gives a path for a failed game.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of feature time with no sponsored cards, which has no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an article-open counter reaching 3, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed or capped. Sponsored cards are hidden temporarily as a reward, and declining leaves the feed as it was.

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner is a card under the category pills on s01, which is rated safe. It is app chrome and not in a chat.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is a product_change that adds a new resource: a window without sponsored cards. The player uses it in the observed core flows f01 and f02 (reading and browsing), and none of it goes to a third party.

c2_evidence.reason: 'The app has no paywall, limit, or currency' and 'This app has nothing locked' are worded as facts about the whole app. The model only records that none was seen on the home feed (open question), so the claim is not supported as worded.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, so there are no paying users to spare.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes and gives away no subscription benefit. It takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears when the reader returns to the feed after a finished read, never mid-article. The banner is also dismissible.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The 'if the ad fails' field grants the prize when the reader closes the game, played or not. That grants the reward on a close and not on the verified play (REWARD_VERIFIED).

c7_specific.reason: It names this app's Taboola native cards in the home feed (s01.e44) and in articles (s02.e13), along with the article-read loop, so it works only here.

other_concern: The offer is framed as trading a game ad for hiding native ads, and it may cannibalize revenue from the cards it hides. The 30-minute value is a prediction and not observed.
